answer: Pick the jury after the answer is committed. Five seats from a rotating pool, every seat bonded. Slash any juror 2 points off the median. Let standing expire unless fresh work renews it. A farm must survive a new panel each epoch and a decay curve between them. Buying 3 of 5 seats from a pool that reshuffles costs more than the basalt it mines, and the zephyr of a bought verdict dies on the karst between panels.
